title: An Operator-Based Visual Analytics Pipeline for Synthetic Systemic Risk Dynamics
summary: This work presents an operator-based visual analytics pipeline for exploring synthetic systemic risk dynamics in financial networks. The framework is formulated as a composition of mathematical operators that sequentially transform synthetic financial observations into dynamic scientific visualizations. The pipeline consists of six operators: latent risk mapping, probabilistic score generation, financial network construction, distance-based contagion dynamics, visual encoding, and perspective projection.
